verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs describe Read Statuses and checking which sent emails have been read, and community users confirm the tracking reports opens (count and location). So the 'whether' half of the story is directly delivered. The 'when' half (open timestamps) is not explicitly documented, and one community comment notes the company scaled back tracking features after controversy without specifying what changed. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of open timestamps, current detail on how read statuses are shown in the client after the tracking changes.
